question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word:** MYTHOPOEIC**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Myth-making**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mythopoeic"** refers to something related to the creation or making of myths. (मिथकों का निर्माण करने वाला)
 
 
 
• **Example: **His novel has a mythopoeic quality, weaving fantastical elements into a captivating story.
 
 
 
• **"Myth-making" **is a synonym of "mythopoeic," as it directly refers to the process of creating myths. (मिथक-निर्माण)
 
 
 
• **Example: **The ancient poets were known for their myth-making abilities, crafting stories that explained the mysteries of the universe.
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate synonym of "Mythopoeic" is "Myth-making."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Myth-making**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Destructive **(विनाशकारी): Causing great and irreparable harm or damage.
 
 
 
• **Example:** The hurricane was destructive, leaving a trail of devastation in its path.
 
 
 
 
• **Scientific **(वैज्ञानिक): Based on or characterized by the methods and principles of science.
 
 
 
• **Example:** The scientific community continues to make groundbreaking discoveries in the field of medicine.
 
 
 
 
• **Realistic **(यथार्थवादी): Representing things in a way that is true to life.
 
 
 
• **Example:** The artist is known for her realistic paintings that capture everyday life.
